verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a compute platform, and a cloud platform could plausibly offer a durable-workflow engine, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only low-level primitives: Machine restart policies [fly-io-docs-26] restart a process after it exits, and Sprite checkpoints [fly-io-docs-4, fly-io-docs-9] save an agent's sandbox state. Nothing shows a workflows-as-code engine with built-in durable steps, queues or retries, and a community user notes even basic cron-style scheduling must be hand-built [fly-io-comm-20].
